description: This file contains Go test code that tests the creation and validation of bug report zip files in an Android Cuttlefish project, including functions for creating bug reports, verifying zip integrity, and ensuring inclusion of specific bug report files.

methods.name: createBugReport
methods.description: Creates a bug report zip file by invoking the CreateBugReport method of the hoclient service and writing to a temporary file.

methods.name: assertZipIntegrity
methods.description: Checks each file in the provided zip archive to verify it can be opened and read without errors.

methods.name: assertAdbBugReportIsIncluded
methods.description: Verifies whether the zip archive contains a bug report file matching a specific regex pattern.
